panels.description: Host uptime.

panels.description: Protocol engines with a live scrape target.

panels.title: Protocols monitored
panels.description: sing-box, xray, WireGuard, AmneziaWG, Telegram, Snowflake, Conduit.

panels.title: Source countries

targets.expr: count(count by (country)(((singbox_active_users_by_country or xray_active_users_by_country or wireguard_active_peers_by_country or amneziawg_active_peers_by_country) or label_replace(conduit_region_connected_clients,"country","$1","region","(.+)") or tor_snowflake_proxy_connections_total)))

panels.description: Distinct source countries across VPN protocols + Conduit + Snowflake bridges.

panels.title: Destination countries
panels.description: Distinct destination countries (sing-box only).

panels.title: Active users / clients by protocol
panels.description: Currently CONNECTED per protocol. WireGuard/AmneziaWG use live peer_active (recent handshake), not the provisioned count — an idle created peer is not counted here.

panels.title: Traffic by protocol (real load)
panels.description: Current throughput share per protocol. This is the honest 'who is actually carrying traffic' view — idle provisioned peers move no bytes.

panels.title: Provisioned peers (created configs)
panels.description: Total CREATED peer configs — WireGuard/AmneziaWG (`*_peers_total`) and xray users. Includes idle/never-connected peers, so this is a capacity/inventory count, NOT a usage measure. Compare with 'active' and 'traffic' at left.

panels.title: Active users / clients over time
panels.description: Connected users/clients per protocol over time (active metrics, same colours as the pie). Snowflake has no concurrent-client gauge, so it appears by country under Sources.

panels.title: Source countries (VPN + Conduit bridge)

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (country)(((singbox_active_users_by_country or xray_active_users_by_country or wireguard_active_peers_by_country or amneziawg_active_peers_by_country) or label_replace(conduit_region_connected_clients,"country","$1","region","(.+)"))))

panels.description: Connected users/peers by source country across sing-box, xray, WireGuard, AmneziaWG, and Conduit's relayed clients. A reach view, not bytes. Top 20.

panels.title: Conduit bridge reach by country
panels.description: Clients this server relays for as a Conduit bridge, by country (top 12).

panels.title: Snowflake reach by country
panels.description: Connections proxied through this server's Snowflake, by client country (top 12). Cumulative Tor-bridge traffic.

panels.title: Bytes by destination port
panels.description: Destination ports. Colours match the protocol pie. Top 14.

panels.title: Bytes by protocol (QUIC/HTTPS split)
panels.description: Ports mapped to protocols, keyed on (port, network): 443/tcp=HTTPS, 443/udp=HTTP/3 (QUIC), 53=DNS, 853=DoT, 19302/3478=STUN. Unmapped fold into 'other'.

panels.title: QUIC share of web (443)
panels.description: Share of port-443 bytes over UDP (HTTP/3 / QUIC) vs TCP (HTTPS).

panels.title: TCP vs UDP
panels.description: Transport split.

panels.title: Port traffic over time
panels.description: Throughput per destination port (top 8).

options.content: **Destination data — sites, ports, protocols and destination countries — is observed by the sing-box exporter only.** Other protocol engines do not emit per-destination metrics. Sites are k-anonymised: those under `SITE_ANALYTICS_MIN_CLIENTS` distinct clients fold into `other`; no client identifier is ever stored.

panels.title: Share of traffic by site
panels.description: Bytes per destination site. 'other' = folded (< k clients).

panels.title: Top sites by connections
panels.description: Cumulative connections per site (top 12).

panels.title: Distinct clients per named site
panels.description: Distinct clients per NAMED site (over the k-anonymity floor). Sites below the floor hide in 'other'.

panels.title: Traffic by destination country
panels.description: Destination geography (sing-box). 'unknown' is the coverage gap by design.

panels.title: Traffic over time by direction
panels.description: Aggregate up/down throughput (sing-box destinations).
